effective_from_evidence.quote: We’ve launched Claude Fable 5 (claude-fable-5), our most capable model open to all customers, alongside Claude Mythos 5 (claude-mythos-5) for Project Glasswing participants. Both models support a 1M token context window by default, 128k max output tokens, and always-on adaptive thinking.
